briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 push multi-agent frontiers amid rising compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with o4 and Grok-3 releases driving capability gains. Investment surges to $15.2B this quarter as nations race for compute dominance. Safety gaps widen in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced agentic reasoning; xAI releases Grok-3 at scale. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.0 enter testing. DeepSeek R2 matches Western performance at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Google announce 10 new hyperscale AI clusters in US and Europe. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving rapidly.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the gap to closed frontier systems before 2027?
